about: Eighteen measurements of the nonlinearity parameter B/A of pure water at atmospheric pressure, from 0 to 100 °C, as Table 8.1 prints them: each row with the year of its measurement and the reference it comes from, which the row carries in attributed_to with the reference list of the chapter spelled out. Several temperatures are measured more than once, by different authors in different years, and each measurement is a row of its own: at 30 °C the page prints four values from 5.18 to 5.38, which is the spread a caller should expect of this quantity. Ten values print a plus-or-minus beside them, which is held in uncertainty. The caption gives the pressure as atmospheric and prints no number for it, so no row holds a pressure. The Year column is the year of each row's reference, except on the six rows of [8.65], which print 2001 where the chapter's reference list dates the paper to 2002; those six serve no year and the defect is registered in docs/ERRATA.md. B/A is dimensionless: with the condensation s = (rho - rho0)/rho0, the adiabatic pressure is p - p0 = A s + (B/2) s^2 + ..., where A = rho0 (dp/drho)_s and B = rho0^2 (d2p/drho2)_s, the page's equations (8.7) to (8.9).
